title: Hardwood Flooring
activity: Timber flooring – conditions, substrate and laying
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Are room conditions within 18–22°C and 40–60% RH?
Sub-floor moisture test done and dry before laying (≤75% RH)?
Timber moisture content 6–9% confirmed with a calibrated meter?
Substrate flat – no more than 3 mm gap under a 2 m straightedge?
Are joints staggered and expansion gaps kept at all perimeters and thresholds?
Is the finished floor protected after laying?
Liquid DPM applied where moisture readings needed it?
Joint at metal trims 2 mm (timber-to-stone/tile and timber-to-timber); 10 mm at timber-to-plywood?
Entrance door threshold grooves correct and level (±1 mm)?
Stair nosings and metal trims fitted neat and secure?
questions.source: AJK flooring ITP 00002 – stair nosing & metal trim

questions.q: Floor protection (Floorprotec breather) laid straight after the floor?
Timber moisture still 6–9% after installation, no cupping or gaps opening?
